references.text: Describes the promised land as flowing with milk and honey, the same promise of a fertile land that God gave to Israel
The spies brought back grapes, pomegranates, and figs from the promised land, confirming the land's fertility
Mentions grain, figs, vineyards, and pomegranates as crops in the promised land
God promises to bless the land's grain, wine, and oil - the same products mentioned in 8:8
God promises grain, wine, and oil as a reward for obedience, the same themes concerning the blessings of the land
Describes the land's wealth with honey, oil, and wheat - the same products as in 8:8
During Solomon's time, the people lived securely with vineyards and fig trees, fulfilling the promise of a fertile land
Mentions the firstfruits of grain, wine, oil, and honey as tithes to the Lord
Describes how the ancestors entered the fertile land with olive groves and fruit trees
God promises to bless grain, wine, and oil when the people turn back to Him
